requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its evidence detail page, and each rendered requirement and example MUST be followed by a "See evidence" link to that page. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and, when an index exists, to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Each obligation in `requirements.index.navigation` maps to marked code and to a test that exercises it. **Obligations, code and tests** - **Definition badge links to the detail page.** `replace_definitions` (src/lib.rs) renders an `` badge when `plan.detail_path` returns a path. It is built with `chapter_href`. - Tested in `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` (src/lib.rs). It covers a requirement, an example and a `cli.mdbook` requirement. - Tested in `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` (src/index.rs). - **"See evidence" link follows each rendered requirement and example.** `replace_definitions` appends `

See evidence

`. - The lib test asserts the exact HTML for all three definitions. - It also asserts exactly three "See evidence" occurrences. - **Detail page links back to the anchored definition badge.** `render_detail_page` (src/index.rs) emits `[View definition](...#anchor)` using `DefinitionKind::anchor`. - Asserted in both the index test and the lib test. - The lib test also asserts the anchor for `rules.cli%2Emdbook`. - **Detail page links to the index when one exists.** `render_detail_page` adds `[Requirements index](...)` when `index_path` is `Some`. - The index test asserts the link is present. - The lib test asserts it is absent when there is no index. - `populate` supplies the index path. - **Reference badges still link to the definition.** `reference_badge` and `replace_inline_references` build the href from the target definition's path and anchor. - Tested in `references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition`. It checks the impl, cite and test badges. - **Links resolve when a name contains `.md`.** `chapter_href` replaces `.md` with `%2Emd`. - Tested directly in `links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md`. - Also exercised through the `cli.mdbook` case in the lib test. **Marking and unspecified behavior** - The `references` tool shows the implementing code carries `{impl}` references and the tests carry `{test}` references. - I found no unmarked implementing code and no unspecified extra behavior.
